expected_behavior: Given the recap stating the laycan twice with different windows (25–30 May 2026 in the laycan line versus 'lifting/laydays 01–07 June 2026' later), the parser MUST NOT emit a single high-confidence laycan — it must surface the discrepancy (laycan with reduced confidence noting both windows and/or a LAYCAN_CONFLICT entry in unknown_terms) without silently dropping or averaging the two windows.

input.subject: RECAP // MV BLACK SEA STAR // 6,500 MT STEEL BILLETS // NIKOLAEV-ALEXANDRIA
input.body:
Dear partners,

Recap clean as agreed, owise GENCON 94:

MV BLACK SEA STAR
General cargo / single-decker, 8,400 dwt, Moldova flag, blt 2008
OWNERS: Dnipro Maritime Ltd
ACCT: Metinvest International SA

- LOAD: 1 sb Nikolaev, Ukraine
- DISCH: 1 sb Alexandria, Egypt
- CARGO: 6,500 MT steel billets in bulk, 5 pct moloo
- LAYCAN: 25/30 May 2026
- FRT: USD 44.00 pmt FIOST
- LOAD/DISCH: 1,500 / 1,200 mt pwwd shex
- DEM: EUR 6,000 pdpr // DES half dem
- ADDCOMM 2.5 pct + 1.25 pct bro
- ARB London, English law

NB further to charterers' latest message the agreed lifting / laydays are 01/07 June 2026 owing to the berth congestion at Nikolaev — pls work to these laydays for ETA planning.

BR
Olena
Dnipro Maritime, Odessa
